name: code-review-usage
description: Review code changes and monitor Codex and Antigravity IDE usage.

codexReview.autoOpen.description: Open all added/modified files in pinned diff tabs and select the first. Deleted files remain in Codex Changes.

codexUsage.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Automatic refresh interval in seconds, used by both the dashboard and background monitoring (minimum 30 seconds). Set to 0 for manual refresh only.

codexReview.enabled.description: Enable code review, change detection and review commands. Applies immediately.

codexUsage.enabled.description: Enable Codex usage monitoring, status bar and dashboard. Disabling stops new usage requests immediately.

antigravityUsage.enabled.description: Monitor Antigravity IDE usage without the separate desktop app or quota extensions. Requires IDE signed in with its language server running; Windows only.

antigravityUsage.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: Antigravity IDE refresh interval in seconds (minimum effective 30). Set 0 for manual refresh only.

antigravityUsage.serverProcessId.description: 0 selects the current extension host language server automatically. Set a specific IDE language-server process ID only if automatic selection is ambiguous; update it after that server restarts.

scripts.test: node --test test/core.test.js test/extension.test.js test/usage.test.js test/dashboard.test.js test/antigravity.test.js
